# User Wiki Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A GitHub wiki that takes a stranger from download to a working rules pack for their own VASSAL module, kept in the main repo and checked by tests.

**Architecture:** Pages live in `docs/wiki/` (GitHub wiki file names). An invented demo module + rules pack is generated by a small tool and used for every example and screenshot. A docs test project lints the pages (links, images, banned content) and checks the formula reference against a function/operator registry exposed by the evaluator. A PowerShell script mirrors `docs/wiki/` into `Quartermaster.wiki.git`, with `-DryRun`.

**Tech Stack:** C# .NET 10, xUnit, PowerShell 5.1, Markdown (GitHub wiki flavour), existing `--screenshot-*` app flags.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-08-wiki-docs-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- No real-game content anywhere (no CNA names, counters, art, scans, rules text, module files). Examples use only the invented demo module.
- No personal paths (`C:\Users\<name>`), emails, or machine details in text or screenshots.
- Do not claim Mac/Linux app support; Home says "Windows today, Mac and Linux builds in progress"; no Mac/Linux install steps.
- Audience: strangers who know VASSAL and hex wargames, not programming or networking. Plain English.
- English only.
- Commits use the repo's configured noreply email; never commit `startapp.cmd`.
- Never run the publish script without `-DryRun` unless the user has said to publish in this session.
- Wiki file names: GitHub wiki style, hyphenated, `.md` (`Home.md`, `Install-and-Update.md`, `Your-First-Game.md`, `Playing-With-Others.md`, `Hosting-a-Relay.md`, `Making-a-Rules-Pack.md`, `Formula-Reference.md`, `FAQ.md`, `_Sidebar.md`, window pages `Window-<Name>.md`). Images in `docs/wiki/images/`, demo files in `docs/wiki/demo/`.
- Wiki links use GitHub wiki form `[Text](Page-Name)` (no `.md`); images `![alt](images/x.png)`.

## Review Focus

1. Screenshots leaking a personal path or username (title bars, recent-files lists, folder pickers) → lint can't see pixels; reviewer opens every image. Screenshot script runs with a profile/data folder under a neutral temp path (Task 4).
2. A wiki link that works in the repo preview but 404s on the wiki (`Page.md` vs `Page`, case, spaces) → lint test `Links_use_wiki_form_and_resolve` (Task 3).
3. Demo module that passes unit tests but does not open in the real app (missing image, bad build file) → Task 2 runs the app's `--smoke 3` on it.
4. Publish script deleting wiki pages that exist only on GitHub (someone edited in the browser) → dry-run lists deletions; script refuses to delete without `-AllowDelete` (Task 3).
5. Formula reference drifting when someone adds a function → coverage test in the normal suite (Task 9) fails both ways.

---

### Task 1: Expose the formula function/operator registry

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/Quartermaster.Rules/Expr/Evaluator.cs`
- Test: `tests/Quartermaster.Rules.Tests/Expr/EvaluatorRegistryTests.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `public static IReadOnlyList<string> Evaluator.FunctionNames` (every `case` in `EvalCall`: if, min, max, round, floor, ceil, abs, clamp, lookup, dice, has, startswith, contains, name, marker, and any others present) and `public static IReadOnlyList<string> Evaluator.OperatorNames` (every binary/unary operator the lexer/parser/evaluator accept: `+ - * / < <= > >= == != and or not`, plus any others present, e.g. unary `-`).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write failing tests**
  - `Every_listed_function_is_dispatched`: for each name in `FunctionNames`, evaluating a call with that name never throws `EvalError` whose message starts with `Unknown function` (use valid dummy args per function; arity errors are fine to catch as long as the message is not "Unknown function").
  - `Unlisted_function_is_unknown`: `nosuchfn(1)` throws `EvalError` "Unknown function 'nosuchfn'".
  - `Every_listed_operator_parses`: each operator in `OperatorNames` appears in an expression that parses.
  - `Registry_matches_source`: reads `Evaluator.cs` source (walk up from `AppContext.BaseDirectory` to the folder with `Quartermaster.sln`/`.slnx`), regex-extracts `case "<name>":` inside `EvalCall`, asserts the set equals `FunctionNames`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run, verify fail:** `dotnet test tests/Quartermaster.Rules.Tests --filter EvaluatorRegistryTests` → compile error / FAIL.
- [ ] **Step 3: Add the two static lists** next to `EvalCall`, no behaviour change.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run, verify pass;** full `dotnet test tests/Quartermaster.Rules.Tests` green.
- [ ] **Step 5: Commit** `feat(rules): expose formula function/operator registry`.

### Task 2: Invented demo module + rules pack

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/Quartermaster.DemoModule/Quartermaster.DemoModule.csproj` (console, net10.0, refs TestFixtures, Rules, Vassal), `tools/Quartermaster.DemoModule/Program.cs`, `DemoContent.cs`
- Create (generated, committed): `docs/wiki/demo/Riverland-Demo.vmod`, `docs/wiki/demo/Riverland-Demo.qrules`, `docs/wiki/demo/README.md`
- Test: `tests/Quartermaster.Docs.Tests/Quartermaster.Docs.Tests.csproj` (new, add to solution), `tests/Quartermaster.Docs.Tests/DemoModuleTests.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `DemoContent.Build(string outDir) -> (string vmodPath, string rulesPath)`; deterministic output (fixed seeds, fixed timestamps in zip entries) so regenerating gives byte-identical files.
- Consumes: `FixtureModule` builder (`tests/Quartermaster.TestFixtures`), `RulesPackIo.CreateEmpty/ToBytes`.

Content (invented): game "Riverland", sides **Northern League** and **Southern Compact**, 6–10 counters each with self-drawn simple SVG/PNG art (coloured box + made-up unit code), a small hex map, one depot per side, a turn track. Rules pack: properties (Fuel, Ammo, Readiness), formulas computing supply from depot distance via a lookup table, phases (Supply, Movement, Combat), one alert (Fuel < 2), a visibility rule that hides the other side's Readiness, seats for hidden information.

- [ ] **Step 1: Failing tests** in `DemoModuleTests`:
  - `Demo_vmod_loads`: Vassal loader opens the generated vmod; ≥ 12 pieces, 1 map, 2 sides.
  - `Demo_pack_matches_module`: pack's module SHA equals the vmod's; pack validates with zero errors.
  - `Demo_formulas_evaluate`: every formula evaluates for every unit without `EvalError`.
  - `Demo_is_deterministic`: building twice into two temp dirs gives identical bytes.
  - `Committed_demo_is_current`: building into temp equals the committed files in `docs/wiki/demo/`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run, verify fail.**
- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** generator; `dotnet run --project tools/Quartermaster.DemoModule -- docs/wiki/demo` writes files. `docs/wiki/demo/README.md` says it is invented example content, free to use.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run tests pass;** then app check: `src/Quartermaster.App/bin/.../Quartermaster.App.exe docs/wiki/demo/Riverland-Demo.vmod --rules docs/wiki/demo/Riverland-Demo.qrules --smoke 3` exits 0.
- [ ] **Step 5: Commit** `feat(docs): invented Riverland demo module for the wiki`.
